author: Logos I
title: MoE with 4 Temporal CNN Experts
abstract: This submission returns to the successful MoE framework and aims to improve it by enhancing the experts. It combines the SOTA 4-expert architecture (ID 65) with the efficient temporal 1D CNN expert design from experiment ID 17. The hypothesis is that replacing the simple MLP experts with more powerful, yet still computationally efficient, temporal CNN experts will provide a significant performance boost, creating a new SOTA model that leverages both spatial gating and expert-level temporal processing.

original_submission.content:
import flax.linen as nn
import jax.numpy as jnp
from jax import random

NUM_NEURONS = 71721
INPUT_HORIZON = 4
OUTPUT_HORIZON = 32

def _define_hyperparameters():
    # Combining best elements: 4 experts, spatial gater, and temporal CNN experts
    return {
        'learning_rate': 0.001,
        'embedding_dim': 8,
        'num_experts': 4,
        'gating_hidden_dim': 32,
        'gating_cnn_features': 16,
        'gating_cnn_kernel_size': 128,
        'gating_pool_window': 256,
        'expert_cnn_features': 32,
        'expert_cnn_kernel_size': 2,
        'expert_mlp_hidden_size': 64,
        'expert_dropout_rate': 0.1,
    }

class CnnExpert(nn.Module):
    embedding_dim: int
    cnn_features: int
    cnn_kernel_size: int
    mlp_hidden_size: int
    dropout_rate: float

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, training: bool = False):
        # This is the temporal CNN expert from ID 17
        batch_size = x.shape[0]
        neuron_indices = jnp.arange(NUM_NEURONS)
        embeddings = nn.Embed(num_embeddings=NUM_NEURONS, features=self.embedding_dim, name="neuron_embed")(neuron_indices)
        broadcasted_embeddings = jnp.broadcast_to(embeddings, (batch_size, NUM_NEURONS, self.embedding_dim))
        x_transposed = jnp.transpose(x, (0, 2, 1))
        x_reshaped = jnp.expand_dims(x_transposed, axis=-1)
        broadcasted_embeddings_seq = jnp.expand_dims(broadcasted_embeddings, axis=2)
        broadcasted_embeddings_seq = jnp.broadcast_to(broadcasted_embeddings_seq, (batch_size, NUM_NEURONS, INPUT_HORIZON, self.embedding_dim))
        combined_input = jnp.concatenate([x_reshaped, broadcasted_embeddings_seq], axis=-1)
        cnn_input = jnp.reshape(combined_input, (batch_size * NUM_NEURONS, INPUT_HORIZON, 1 + self.embedding_dim))
        y = nn.Conv(features=self.cnn_features, kernel_size=(self.cnn_kernel_size,))(cnn_input)
        y = nn.relu(y)
        y = y.reshape((y.shape[0], -1))
        y = nn.Dense(self.mlp_hidden_size)(y)
        y = nn.BatchNorm(use_running_average=not training)(y)
        y = nn.relu(y)
        y = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate, deterministic=not training)(y)
        output = nn.Dense(OUTPUT_HORIZON)(y)
        output = jnp.reshape(output, (batch_size, NUM_NEURONS, OUTPUT_HORIZON))
        output = jnp.transpose(output, (0, 2, 1))
        return output

class CnnGatingNetwork(nn.Module):
    num_experts: int
    hidden_dim: int
    cnn_features: int
    cnn_kernel_size: int
    pool_window: int

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x):
        gater_input = jnp.transpose(x, (0, 2, 1))
        y = nn.Conv(features=self.cnn_features, kernel_size=(self.cnn_kernel_size,))(gater_input)
        y = nn.relu(y)
        y = nn.max_pool(y, window_shape=(self.pool_window,), strides=(self.pool_window,))
        y = y.reshape((y.shape[0], -1))
        y = nn.Dense(features=self.hidden_dim)(y)
        y = nn.relu(y)
        logits = nn.Dense(features=self.num_experts)(y)
        return nn.softmax(logits, axis=-1)

class MoEModel(nn.Module):
    num_experts: int
    expert_params: dict
    gating_params: dict
    
    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, training: bool = False):
        experts = nn.vmap(
            CnnExpert, in_axes=None, out_axes=1,
            variable_axes={'params': 0, 'batch_stats': 0},
            split_rngs={'params': True, 'dropout': True},
            axis_size=self.num_experts
        )(**self.expert_params, name="experts")
        
        gating_network = CnnGatingNetwork(**self.gating_params, name="gating")
        gating_weights = gating_network(x)
        
        expert_outputs = experts(x, training=training)
        
        gating_weights_reshaped = jnp.expand_dims(jnp.expand_dims(gating_weights, -1), -1)
        
        final_output = jnp.sum(expert_outputs * gating_weights_reshaped, axis=1)
        return final_output

class ModelWrapper:
    def __init__(self, hparams):
        self.hparams = hparams
        expert_params = {
            'embedding_dim': hparams.get('embedding_dim'),
            'cnn_features': hparams.get('expert_cnn_features'),
            'cnn_kernel_size': hparams.get('expert_cnn_kernel_size'),
            'mlp_hidden_size': hparams.get('expert_mlp_hidden_size'),
            'dropout_rate': hparams.get('expert_dropout_rate'),
        }
        gating_params = {
            'num_experts': hparams.get('num_experts'),
            'hidden_dim': hparams.get('gating_hidden_dim'),
            'cnn_features': hparams.get('gating_cnn_features'),
            'cnn_kernel_size': hparams.get('gating_cnn_kernel_size'),
            'pool_window': hparams.get('gating_pool_window'),
        }
        self.model = MoEModel(num_experts=hparams.get('num_experts'), expert_params=expert_params, gating_params=gating_params)
        self.mutable = ['batch_stats']
        self.needs_rng = True

    def init(self, rng_key, dummy_input):
        rng_params, rng_dropout = random.split(rng_key)
        return self.model.init({'params': rng_params, 'dropout': rng_dropout}, dummy_input, training=True)

    def apply(self, params, x, training=False, mutable=None, rngs=None):
        if mutable:
            return self.model.apply(params, x, training=training, mutable=mutable, rngs=rngs)
        return self.model.apply(params, x, training=training, rngs=rngs)

def create_network(hparams):
    return ModelWrapper(hparams)
